answer: Make each agent answer a unique sonnet-length challenge whose wording is generated from its own history, then require the reply to cite a ferrous proof token minted only after a slow hardware attestation. Peers replay a sample and publish a crystal-clear verdict; contradictions burn the agent's bond and freeze its queue. Wording derived from private history cannot be pre-shared across a wallet swarm, and slow attestation caps how many identities one machine can mint per day, so copying accounts costs more than performing honest work.
